properties.name: light
properties.description: Light on/off (1400) — lit right now, not a setting: it follows whichever client is streaming. Verified via P2P state readback (3/3); session-scoped behaviour measured live on a T8170.

properties.name: brightness
properties.description: Manual brightness, range 1-100 (1401). Verified live (T8425 + T8124).

properties.name: spotlightEnabled
properties.description: The spotlight master switch, distinct from the on/off above — whether the spotlight may light at all. Read verified live on a T8170 (param 1403, direct polarity: 1 = enabled).
